questions.q: Because God is holy, what does Peter say you shall be?
questions.evidence: because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy

questions.q: What kind of priesthood does Peter call believers?
questions.evidence: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light

questions.q: Be ready to give an answer for what, Peter says?
options: The hope that is in you
questions.evidence: and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear

questions.q: Like what does the devil walk around, seeking whom he may devour?
questions.evidence: Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour
